title.narrative: National Tuberculosis Program - Viet Nam (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Viet Nam, Tuberculosis, Viet Nam National Lung Hospital (NTP)This program has the following goals: Find and treat all TB cases to decrease transmission. Find and treat those who are infected with TB to prevent progression to active disease. The objectives of this program are: A 50 percent reduction of the incidence of TB by 2026 compared to 2018. A 75 percent reduction in TB mortality in 2026 compared to 2018 (<4 people per 100,000). Maintain the proportion of MDR-TB among newly diagnosed TB patients below 5 percent
